dawn.description: Advisory: the night was won — the President's hat came off, or the night's cap was reached.

seed.description: Which horde: a date (YYYY-MM-DD, local to the player) for the nightly horde, or any word for a practice one. The sim seeds from the FNV-1a hash of this string.

wave.description: Advisory: the wave the steps fell in.

fires.description: The whole run as the only input the game takes. Comma-separated `<dtick>.<weapon>.<x>.<z>` entries: dtick is 60 Hz ticks since the previous entry, weapon is 0 mist, 1 pulse, 2 drop, 3 for giving up (the run ends on that entry; x and z are 0), or 4 for a heading on an airlift level (x and z are then the direction in tenths, 0 and 0 to hover), x and z are otherwise the ground point in tenths of a unit (x east, z south, origin at the Washington Monument). Only shots the sim accepted are logged; a verifier applies the same rate, heat and cooldown rules and refuses a log that fires faster than they allow. Example: `120.0.-402.12,5.0.-398.14,30.1.-390.10`.

level.description: The level the run was played on. Ids are append-only.

rules.description: The level's own rules version the run was played under. A verifier must replay under the matching version or refuse the run. Absent means 1.

stage.description: Deprecated: an earlier build's stage index. Superseded by level.

ticks.description: Advisory: the tick the steps fell.

holdPeak.description: Advisory: the most people sheltering at once.

rehatted.description: Advisory: cured people the horde caught again.

simVersion.description: Which rules produced these shots. A verifier must replay under the matching version or refuse the run.

main.description: One Hats Off run, published by the player into their own repo. The record stores every shot rather than a score: the sim is deterministic, so re-running the fire log against the same seed on the same level reproduces the run exactly. Owning the record is the identity proof, and replaying it is the score proof — wave, cured and the rest are advisory and never trusted by a leaderboard.
